definition: Generate a broad candidate parameter space, train an ANN meta-model to approximate simulator outputs, and use global search over the surrogate to identify parameters matching measured battery curves.
non_negotiable_steps: ANN surrogate training on simulator-generated input-output pairs
Curve-matching objective against measured battery data
Report identified interpretable parameters and fit error
assumptions: A reduced-order physics-inspired simulator can stand in for unavailable full ECAT solver
Observed datasets are sufficient for curve-level validation even without destructive cell teardown
deviations_from_exact_target: Full electrochemical-aging-thermal PDE solver unavailable in workspace
Search uses ANN surrogate over a reduced-order discharge/thermal simulator rather than a full ECAT model
Optimization will be implemented with deterministic/random search rather than exact published MMGA unless evidence suggests otherwise
